questions.q: OABC is a parallelogram with OA = a and OC = c. M is the midpoint of AB and N is on CB with CN : NB = 2 : 1. (a) Find AB, OM and ON in terms of a and c [4] (b) Find MN [2] (c) X is on OB with OX : XB = 3 : 1. Find OX [2] (d) P is the point with OP = 2a + c. Prove that O, M and P are collinear [4]
questions.a: (a) AB = c, OM = a + ½c, ON = c + ⅔a (b) MN = ½c - ⅓a (c) OB = a + c, OX = ¾(a + c) (d) OP = 2(a + ½c) = 2 OM, sharing O, so O, M, P are collinear
questions.model: (a) AB = OC = c; OM = a + ½c; ON = c + ⅔a (CB = a). (b) ON - OM = ⅔a + c - a - ½c = ½c - ⅓a. (c) ¾ of OB. (d) as shown.

questions.q: In triangle OAB, OA = a, OB = b. P divides OA in the ratio 1 : 2 and Q divides OB in the ratio 1 : 2. Prove PQ is parallel to AB and find the ratio PQ : AB.
questions.a: PQ = ⅓b - ⅓a = ⅓(b - a) = ⅓AB; parallel, ratio 1 : 3

questions.q: OA = a, OB = b, M is the midpoint of AB. Find OM.
questions.model: OM = OA + ½AB = a + ½(b - a) = ½a + ½b.

questions.q: AB = 3a + b and BC = 6a + 2b. What can you say about A, B and C?
questions.a: BC = 2AB and they share B, so A, B, C are collinear

questions.q: To prove collinear you need a multiple AND
